        }

/**
 * Copies the provided text to the clipboard.
 * If the Clipboard API is available, it uses it; otherwise, it falls back to creating a temporary textarea element to copy the text.
 * @global
 * @param {string} text The text to be copied to the clipboard.
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} A promise that resolves to true if the text was successfully copied, or false if it failed.
 */
async function copy_text(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
        return true
    }

    const $e = create_element(
        'textarea',
        {
            value: text,
            focus: true,
            select: true,
            style: {
                top: '0',
                left: '0',
                position: 'fixed',
            },
        },
        document.body,
    )
    try {
        return document.execCommand('copy')
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('unable to copy', e)
    } finally {
        document.body.removeChild($e)
    }
    return false
}

 * @param {boolean} [params.noclose=false] Whether to prevent closing the login modal without logging in if a 401 response is received.
 * @returns {Promise<Response | void>} The response from the fetch request.
 */
async function auth_fetch(path, options, { noclose = false } = {}) {
    const r = await fetch(
        `https://${SUB_API}.nopecha.com${path.startsWith('/') ? path : '/' + path}`,
        {
            ...options,
            credentials: 'include',

    )
    if (r.status === 401) {
        open_login_modal({ noclose })
        return
    }
    return r
}
